reviews.title: Plug and Play
reviews.comment: Plug and play, worked like a charm and it seems stable. Even though it's an older chip for the value it's great performance.
reviews.author: YoungRich

reviews.title: Just what I needed to upgrade my household server project.
reviews.comment: I bought a used HP server to run my smart home and plex server and I wanted to upgrade my processor to the highest level the motherboard would take. I found a great deal here on Amazon. Great price, great service.
reviews.author: MisterFixIt1952

reviews.title: Crazy price for what you get
reviews.comment: Insane that these haven’t been eaten up, the single core performance is surprisingly good, and 24 threads are nice. Using 2 of these for my game servers. Works well with no issues.
reviews.author: Erin Leonello

reviews.title: Does not work with 2400 memory
reviews.comment: Took me a while to figure the DL380 Gen9 problem, 2680v4 is supposed to support 2400 memory and system halts. I ended up finding extra memory sticks of 2133 and system booted correctly.  With this CPU with 2400, it says memory not installed.  I even narrowed it down to 1 stick, same problem.
reviews.author: Brad L.
